One 13/14 scheme became independently funded in 15/16.  Three new schemes were introduced to the LAA scheme in 15/16 when previous independent funding came to an end.
HPCDS procurement area names are based on the amalgamation of the current LAA Housing and Debt procurement area names.
The courts listed take into account the HMCTs court closure programme and where work will be undertaken from 2018

The court based housing possession service run in the Isle of Wight is funded through alternative funding arrangements. It is only listed here as the LAA define Portsmouth and the Isle of Wight as a single area for the current procurement of Housing and Debt advice services
